profileText: a Representative from Arizona; born in Seattle, King County, Wash., April 7, 1992; graduated from Chaparral High School, Scottsdale, Ariz., 2010; B.A., Stanford University, Stanford, Calif., 2014; M. Phil., University of Cambridge, Cambridge, England; staff, United Nations, 2015-2021; member of the Phoenix, Ariz., city council, 2021-2024; vice mayor, Phoenix, Ariz., 2023-2024; elected as a Democrat to the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress (January 3, 2025-present).
